t: Context Telemetry: Mastering AI Prompt Size Limits
s: The article introduces 'context telemetry' as a method to overcome AI prompt size limits by bundling extensive, structured context for complex systems like Pipulate. It details how this local, sovereign AI development platform, built on Nix, FastHTML, and Jupyter, uses such 'mega-submits' for phantom-user test automation.
sub: Pipulate: Local Sovereign AI Dev Platform
